# Yesterdays

[![Donate](https://img.shields.io/badge/Donate-green?logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://openstreetmap.app.neoncrm.com/forms/support-yesterdays)


A Django web application for georeferencing historical images.

[Check out the live site](https://yesterdays.today), or [read our documentation](https://docs.yesterdays.today/).

## Development

We welcome anyone who wishes to contribute code to Yesterdays, or build their own applications atop our API.
Please start with our [documentation for contributors](https://docs.yesterdays.today/dev/contributing/), and feel free to [reach out](https://docs.yesterdays.today/contact) with any questions.
